TOOLCHAIN_SETUP:
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
              with:
                  flutter-version: '3.44.7'
                  channel: 'stable'
                  cache: true
BUILD_TOOLS: Bash(flutter test:*),Bash(flutter analyze:*),Bash(flutter pub get:*),Bash(dart run tool/check_docs.dart:*)
VERIFY_CHECKS:
run_check "flutter analyze" flutter analyze --fatal-infos
                  run_check "flutter test" flutter test
                  run_check "check_docs" dart run tool/check_docs.dart
